speaker: Doctor
text: Have you experienced any recent headaches, vision changes, or difficulty speaking? I also need to know if you have a history of high blood pressure, diabetes, or heart disease.

speaker: Doctor

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: MRI_Brain Findings: Lesions consistent with Progressive Multifocal Encephalopathy (PML). Comments: T1/T2 images showing multifocal demyelinating lesions without gadolinium enhancement, indicative of PML.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The MRI findings confirm Progressive Multifocal Encephalopathy (PML), a serious opportunistic infection associated with natalizumab therapy. We must immediately discontinue the medication and initiate a multidisciplinary management plan to address this condition.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML)
